claim: With the binary log on and synced at every group, a short group commit delay gathers more transactions per sync: binlog syncs per transaction fall.
note: 2026-11-04 (atvbm2): syncs per transaction -58% as predicted, throughput -24.5%: at no delay the binary log already synced once per ~39 commits (0.026 per trx), so the delay only added wait. The claim on throughput is refuted on this disk; the group-commit-delay rule now needs binlog syncs per transaction >= 0.1 measured.
